splash.title: Great House Farm
items: 1667: Family 'Buys' Farm, Estate Secretly Logs Them as Tenants
1840s–80s: Ancient Manor Rebranded 'Farm' to Erase Family's Status
1870: Roman Soldier Found Under Floor, Authorities Bury the Evidence
1895–1905: Quarry Cashes In, Promised Deeds to Williams Vanish Without Trace
1938: Family Home Sold Over Their Heads in Paper-Only Auction
1955: Disabled Mother Left Clinging to House as Court Strips Her Land
1959–65: Widow's Ancestral Title Laughed Off, She's Recast as Squatter
1974: BP Fakes 'Mrs Buckler' Licence to Kill Williams' Land Rights
1987–88: Court Endorses Paper Trick; BP Smashes 800-Year Home, Son Silenced
1994–2026: Wales' Largest Cemetery Built Over; No Inquiry
Feb 2026 Restitution Claim Stands at £101.2M and counting
May 2026: HER Record GGAT02038s Confirms BP Demolition Dec 1988, Medieval Origins, Vaughan Tenure from C16th
